product.name: Monoprice Commercial Series Floor to Ceiling Wire Mount System for Portrait and Landscape Displays Fits 43 to 65 TVs
product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series Floor to Ceiling Wire Mount System for Portrait and Landscape Displays, Fits 43" to 65" TVsThe Monoprice Commercial Series Floor to Ceiling Wire Mount System for Landscape and Portrait Displays delivers a clean, modern solution for mounting landscape or portrait-oriented displays using a tensioned wire system that runs from floor to ceiling. Ideal for retail, corporate, and hospitality environments, this design minimizes visual clutter while maintaining commercial-grade strength and stability. Engineered for professional AV installations, the mount supports landscape and portrait displays from 43" to 65", making it well suited for digital signage, menus, information displays, and promotional content in high-visibility indoor spaces.Tensioned wire system creates a sleek “floating” display appearance without wall mountingSupports 43" to 65" portrait displays and 50" to 65" landscape displays with a maximum load of 66 lbs (30 kgs)Compatible with VESA patterns from 100×100 to 400×600 mmAdjustable mounting height for flexible placement within the available floor-to-ceiling spanMaximum floor-to-ceiling height of 3300 mm (129.9 in) for tall commercial spacesIdeal for glass walls and open architectural designs where wall mounting is not possibleAvailable in black for a consistent, professional commercial aestheticDesigned for indoor use only; professional installation and regular inspection recommended FLOOR TO CEILING WIRE MOUNT ARCHITECTUREA tensioned wire system anchors securely between the floor and ceiling, creating a sleek “floating” appearance without the need for wall mounting—ideal for glass walls and open architectural designs. LANDSCAPE DISPLAY ORIENTATIONDesigned specifically for landscape and portrait mode displays, supporting widescreen content such as menus, dashboards, directories, and advertising panels. ADJUSTABLE MOUNTING HEIGHTThe wire system allows installers to position the display at the desired height within the available floor-to-ceiling span, enabling flexible placement for varying room layouts and viewing distances. COMMERCIAL GRADE LOAD SUPPORTSupports displays up to 66 lbs (30 kgs) per screen, providing reliable performance for professional flat panel displays in continuous operation environments. PROFESSIONAL INDOOR INSTALLATIONIntended for indoor use only and designed for professional installation.
